why: The tatliq ground of the husband's conviction for an offence touching the family's honour: which offences (family abandonment and the chapter around it) the Penal Code puts in that class.
Whether the family judge must defer a tatliq based on harm (beating) while a public action on the same facts is pending.
The 1984 wording of the grounds article, to see what the 2005 amendment changed for facts that predate it.
